content.subject: Fulfyld fulfillment services and data reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi AJ,
Fulfyld lists core, 3PL, and platform-specific fulfillment services. Managing those varied offerings creates many manual reconciliation steps.
We embed a data-matching engine that auto-reconciles inventory and order records across channels.
Would you be open to a 15‑minute conversation later this week to see if it fits?
Zamp
